shared_tail.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن الأصم

notes: «جميعا عن سفيان» converges two routes; the common tail is written once and is the shared tail (rule 3).
«عن عمه، يزيد بن الأصم» : «عمه» is folded into the name (rule 7); Maymuna speaks the saying, so she is the last link.
The gloss «- قال يحيى أخبرنا سفيان بن عيينة -» is a remark on the same name, left out.
